dialogues.speaker: Najia
dialogues.text: If only I could be as open-minded as you are.

dialogues.speaker: Najia
dialogues.text: Maybe it all comes down to the fact that I'm so attached to this theater, and that I have certain demands on myself.

dialogues.speaker: Najia
dialogues.text: Anyway, thank you for comforting me. Here are some leftover rocks from what we made props with. They are quality rocks. Please take them.
